name: Talk With You ~Onna no Ko to Ohanashi Suru Game~
original_name: Talk With You～おんなのことおはなしするゲーム～
source:
It's really just a game where you talk with a girl.
Let's choose a topic and have fun talking with her.

[Translated from [url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/simulation/game_10457.html]Freegame-mugen[/url]]
translation:
这实际上只是一个与女孩交谈的游戏。
我们选择一个话题，和她愉快地交谈吧。

[译自[url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/simulation/game_10457.html]Freegame-mugen[/url]]
